articles.title: India Excludes Sugar-Based Ethanol From 2026-27 Petrol Blend Tender
articles.description: The Indian government has decided to exclude ethanol derived from sugarcane juice, sugar syrup, and B-heavy molasses from its latest procurement tender for the 2026-27 supply year. This decision aims to safeguard domestic sugar supplies while continuing the nationwide petrol-blending initiative. articles.title: DH Evening Brief | Seven, including organisers, arrested in Kolkata pandal stampede; India bars sugarcane-based ethanol from 2026-27 procurement tender to safeguard sugar supplies
articles.description: Ethanol procurement: State-run oil marketing companies exclude sugarcane-based ethanol from the 2026-27 procurement tender following government directions to halt sugar diversion for fuel amid domestic availability concerns and price stability targets.

articles.title: Delhi court rejects bail pleas of former DGHS Vatsala Aggarwal, Vinod Kumar Ranga
articles.description: The Rouse Avenue Court on Saturday rejected the bail applications of former Director General of Health Services DGHS Dr Vatsala Aggarwal and Dr Vinod Kumar Ranga in an alleged Rs 700-crore corruption case involving the procurement of medical goods at higher prices citing the gravity of the offences and the need for further investigation Their continued custody is necessary in order to ensure fair and unhindered investigation as there is apprehension that they may influence the investigation the court said
